question: Are data centres now front-line targets, yes or no?

lines.text: A drone attack has set fire to Yandex's data centre in Sasovo, Russia, the company says.
lines.note: TASS: Yandex reports fire at data center in Sasovo, Ryazan Region, following drone attack

lines.text: Yandex says operations there are fully suspended, and some services may be unavailable.
lines.note: TASS: 'The data center's operations have been fully suspended and some Yandex services may be unavailable to users.'

lines.text: Yandex describes it as its largest data centre, Kyiv Independent reports.
lines.note: Kyiv Independent: Yandex describes it as its largest data center; DCD same

lines.text: Yandex Cloud's status page shows the outage began at 1:31am.
lines.note: Kyiv Independent: disruptions began around 1:31 a.m.; DCD: Yandex Cloud status dashboard notes power outage at ru-central-b zone starting 1:31am local time

lines.text: In 2022, Ryazan's governor said the complex houses tens of thousands of servers.
lines.note: Kyiv Independent: Governor Pavel Malkov in 2022 described the complex as housing 'tens of thousands of servers'

lines.text: Yandex says there were no casualties.
Downdetector logged over 1,300 problem reports, The Moscow Times says.
lines.note: Moscow Times: Downdetector recorded more than 1,300 user reports of disruptions

lines.text: Yandex Cloud, Documents and Tables were disrupted, while search and taxi stayed online.
lines.note: Moscow Times: disruptions to Yandex Cloud, Yandex Documents and Yandex Tables; search and taxi remained online

lines.text: Yandex shares fell more than 3.4 percent in Moscow trading.
lines.note: Moscow Times: Yandex shares fell more than 3.4% in Thursday morning trading on the Moscow Exchange

lines.text: The Moscow Times calls it the first confirmed strike on Russian data infrastructure since 2022.
lines.note: Moscow Times: first confirmed strike against Russian data infrastructure since the 2022 invasion; DCD: first major data center taken down in Russia during the conflict

lines.text: It reports Russian strikes on at least eight data centres in Kyiv since late September.
lines.note: Moscow Times: since late September, Russian forces have reportedly hit at least eight major data centers in Kyiv

lines.text: Russia's Defence Ministry says it downed 399 Ukrainian drones overnight.
lines.note: Moscow Times: air defence intercepted 399 Ukrainian drones over 18 Russian regions and annexed Crimea overnight (MoD)

lines.text: Are data centres now front-line targets, yes or no?

caption: Yandex, Sasovo: a drone attack has set fire to Yandex's largest data centre, in Russia's Ryazan region, and the company says operations there are fully suspended. The Moscow Times calls it the first confirmed strike on Russian data infrastructure since 2022. Are data centres now front-line targets, yes or no?
notes_full: First reported 8 Oct: outage from 01:31 local (22:31 UTC 7 Oct), Kyiv Independent 03:14 UTC, Reuters 06:19, CNBC 07:52, Moscow Times, TASS, NBC, DCD; about 9h old at delivery
Removal-risk: an event that happened, claims attributed (Yandex, Moscow Times, Russia's MoD); no casualties; no toll; no future-attack framing; neutral yes/no
